com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Settings styling now covers every nested destination and modal, including provisioning-profile details and the Apple Developer Portal. Normal entry typography, grouped surfaces and technical fields are consistent. Initial integrated VPN configuration now sets the complete provider protocol before saving, fixing the missing-protocol error.
